prayerExcerpt.en-US: The example of Our Saviour and of all His saints ought to encourage us under all trials to suffer with patience and even with joy.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: O exemplo de Nosso Salvador e de todos os Seus santos deve encorajar-nos, em todas as provações, a sofrer com paciência e até com alegria.

meta.face: A Roman of about sixty with a warm olive complexion and a BROAD, SHORT face whose width is in the FLARING, fleshy cheekbones — a LOW forehead crossed by one DEEP horizontal crease, thick, tight, grizzled CURLS growing low on it, LARGE, slightly PROTRUDING dark eyes under HIGH, thick, ARCHED brows that give a searching look, a SHORT, WIDE, straight nose with round nostrils, FULL, curving lips, a full, CURLY, rounded grey-black beard of medium length; the gaze direct and earnest.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The book tells a Roman by birth who succeeded Dionysius in 269, recourse to Aurelian against Paul of Samosata, and his martyrdom in 274; Wikipedia says he was buried in the catacomb of Callixtus and that the martyrdom is a later confusion with a namesake of the Via Aurelia (hence the patron line 'Pope'). The Italian Wikipedia's lead image, a papal portrait medallion of the kind in St. Paul's Outside the Walls, shows him with thick curly hair and a full curly beard; the card keeps the curls and beard, and the broad, short face with the prominent eyes is our choice.
